name: sofa-goblin
description: A calm, offline-first LG webOS launcher with optional on-TV Home routing and remote protection

scripts.package: npm run build && ares-package dist --outdir build
scripts.check: node --check app/app.js && node --check app/platform.js && node --check app/photos.js && node --check scripts/build.mjs && node --check scripts/import-photos.mjs && node --check tv/luna.js && node --check tv/home-manager.js && node --check scripts/tv-control.mjs && node --check scripts/tv-config.mjs
scripts.test: node --test tests/home-manager.test.cjs tests/tv-config.test.mjs && npm run test:guard
